html:
G'oya

Xodim bo'limsiz ham mavjud bo'la oladi, shuning uchun bo'lim yopilganda uni o'chirish emas, havolani uzish kerak: ON DELETE SET NULL. Buning uchun ustun NULL ni qabul qilishi shart.

Yechim

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  department_id INTEGER REFERENCES departments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  salary INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (salary > 0)
)

Namunada Moliya bo'limi yopildi: Malika va Bekzod qoldi, ularning department_id si endi NULL. Jasurning 9-bo'limi umuman yo'q, u qo'shilmadi.

Tuzoqlar

ON DELETE qaysi variant tanlanishi masalaning mazmunidan kelib chiqadi:

Variant Bo'lim o'chirilganda
yozilmagan (NO ACTION) o'chirish rad etiladi
CASCADE xodimlar ham o'chadi
SET NULL xodimlar qoladi, bo'limi NULL

CASCADE bu yerda eng xavflisi: bo'lim yopilishi bilan xodimlar bazadan izsiz yo'qoladi.

Noto'g'riCREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  department_id INTEGER REFERENCES departments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  salary INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (salary > 0)
)

SET NULL ni NOT NULL ustunga qo'ysangiz, bir-biriga zid ikki qoida chiqadi va o'chirish baribir rad etiladi.
